title: CollectDatalakeDiagnosticsRequest
description: Request object for collecting DataLake diagnostics.

destination.description: Destination of the diagnostics collection (Support, Own cloud storage, Engineering or collect only on the nodes)

description.description: Additional information / title for the diagnostics collection.

caseNumber.description: Optional support case number in case of SUPPORT destination, otherwise only act as additional data.

labels.description: Array of labels that can filter logs that are collected during diagnostics collection.

startDate.description: Date timestamp - collect files only for diagnostics that has higher last modified timestamp value than this.

endDate.description: Date timestamp - collect files only for diagnostics that has lower created timestamp value than this.

additionalLogs.description: Array of log descriptors that should be additionally collected during diagnostics collection.

hosts.description: Array of host names (fqdn), collection will run only on the dedicated hosts.

hostGroups.description: Array of host groups, collection will run only on the dedicated hosts that belongs to these host groups.

excludeHosts.description: Array of host names (fqdn or IP address), collection will not run on the excluded hosts.

skipUnresponsiveHosts.description: Skip unhealthy hosts from the diagnostics collection.

includeNginxReport.description: Include Nginx report generated by GoAccess (if available).

includeSaltLogs.description: Include salt minion/master/api system logs in the diagnostics collection.

includeSarOutput.description: Include SAR (System Activity Report) generated outputs in the diagnostics collection (if available).

updatePackage.description: If enabled, required package (cdp-telemetry) will be upgraded or installed on the nodes. (useful if package is not installed or needs to be upgraded) Network is required for this operation.

storageValidation.description: Enable/disable node level storage validation (can be disabled for example, if you have too many hosts and do not want to do too much parallel writes to s3/abfs)

DatalakeVmLogRequest.description: Log descriptor, contains a path and label pair. Used for diagnostics collections.

path.description: Path of the log file(s) that needs to be collected. (Can be glob wildcard)

label.description: Label that will be used to identify a log descriptor. (will be used as a folder inside logs folder)
